title: Great Lavra Bell Tower
geometryBasis: The named native tower envelope fixes the center and footprint. The preserve’s record supplies a 29m base diameter and 96.52m total height. The 29-vertex mapped circle is reconstructed as the eight-sided tower visible in the cleared photograph.
sectionBasis: The July 2013 whole-tower image establishes the ochre base, solid lower colonnade, two open upper colonnades, heavy terraces and gilded dome. The detail image supplies the eagle capitals. Stage heights and off-camera details are photo estimates.
limitations: The total height and base diameter follow the preserve record. Individual tier heights, upper sections, octagon rotation, rear openings and bell positions are estimated from the July 2013 photographs.
Ceramic ornament, eagle reliefs and classical capitals are simplified for medium-fi viewing. The photographed yellow, white, green and gold palette is approximate under different lighting.
The original composite elevation field is preserved. It slopes around the tower plaza, so exposed foundation depth and contact are approximate.
